headline: More time for TensorWave
mechanism: Fermi extended the first TensorWave lease closing from September 30th to October 31st, 2026 at Project Matador in Carson County. The lease takes effect only after guaranties, construction funding and other closing conditions are satisfied or waived, so the picture shows an unbuilt parcel, a closing gate only partly open, and terrace steps whose upper tiers remain outlines. No completed or powered campus is drawn.
silhouette: flat parcel slab with one half-open pivot gate and three unfilled terrace steps

visual_anchors.claim: Project Matador is in the Texas Panhandle on Texas Tech University System ground-leased land in Carson County.
visual_anchors.drawn_as: two concrete pillars over an unbuilt pad, with the dashed gap between pads marking ground not built

visual_anchors.claim: Fermi disclosed the signed TensorWave closing extension on September 22nd, 2026; the deadline changed from September 30th to October 31st, 2026. A separate amendment execution date is not established.
visual_anchors.drawn_as: brass calendar tab with SEP 30 and OCT 31 date leaves at its two ends

visual_anchors.claim: The amendment leaves the remaining terms unchanged. Effectiveness requires satisfaction or waiver of closing conditions including work letters, guaranties, operations schedules, service-level agreement, board approvals and construction financing.
visual_anchors.drawn_as: dashed brass span across the middle of the tab, marking closing conditions not yet satisfied

gaps_respected: Lease extension is conditional; no completed closing or guaranty is drawn.
No powered campus, racks or completed construction are drawn; the 222 MW figure is contracted scope, not depicted output.

visual_review.findings: Inspected full-size cover and 300 px thumbnail. Art reads before the headline; focal object sits in 180..680.
